device_id.description: USB device to export in format vendorid:prodid (e.g., 046d:c52b). One of busnum-devnum or vendor:product.

to_addr.description: Target addr:port to connect to. Used when usbredirect acts as a client exporting to a remote server.

as_addr.description: Local addr:port to listen on. Used when usbredirect acts as a server exporting to a remote client.
